name: Roccat Vulcan keyboards
description: Per-key lighting of the Roccat Vulcan family in direct mode: Vulcan 100 / 120-Series Aimo, Vulcan TKL, Vulcan Pro, Vulcan TKL Pro, Vulcan II, Vulcan II Max, Vulcan II Mini, Pyro, Magma and Magma Mini. Adapted from OpenRGB's RoccatVulcanKeyboardController (GPL-2.0-or-later); untested on hardware. OpenRGB's mode report (SendMode, kept by the keyboard) is never sent: Lightloom only switches direct mode on, and off again at shutdown, which hands the keyboard back to its stored lighting. Protocol notes: docs/hardware/roccat-vulcan.md.
